notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43380606/f65faacb5fbbfb23b782d11b208b3fba730ba86b.png[/img]





HI there!
Did i ever say that i'm forever grateful for all the support you guys gave me? No?
well,

[b]THANK YOU, FOR REAL. THANK YOU SO MUCH.[/b]

Sometimes life is hard, sometimes life is easy, but no matter what i'll continue to make games for you all. Maybe some of my future games will suck, but don't worry, i'll always try to improve and do better. I'm rly glad to have this small but amazing community of followers, this rly makes me want to continue to create new games, and its much more important than money to me.

So, whats in store for 2023? Well, the sequel to REDO!, of course!

Here is a not-so-precise roadmap for SESSIONS 2023.

Jan - dev
Feb - new trailer, dev
mar - dev
apr- Demo, dev
may - dev
Jun - Updated demo, new trailer, steam fest
july - dev
aug - dev
set - Final trailer,dev

oct ~ dec = full release.


btw, happy new year!

notes.title: SESSIONS
notes.content:
Hello!

Well, it's finally here: the sequel to REDO!
So, what's SESSIONS ABOUT? How does it connect to the first game?

SESSIONS expands the world and lore of REDO!. It uses the previously established world and lore as a base for a more expansive story. I don't want to delve into details about the story, but I'll talk a bit about it.
The game takes place hundreds of years after the events of REDO! After such a long time, the world has changed dramatically. There are no signs of human life, only the remaining man-made machines, synthetic humanoids, and eldritch abominations can be found.
You play as a synthetic human with a personal mission. And she will journey to the ends of the earth to fulfill it.
This brings me to another point: the journey. You won't be restricted to one city, like in REDO! You'll travel from place to place, exploring the ruins of human civilization.

Action. Horror. Exploration.

Action: Your movement and combat are similar to REDO!, but more fluid and a little more rapid. The game is still slow-paced, but you can expect more fluid combat, platforming, and overall movement.

Horror: SESSIONS will amplify the horror aspect of REDO! Don't expect jump scares or things like that. I'm talking about a sense of dread, hopelessness, creepy environments and enemy design.

Exploration: Yes, you'll have a map this time. More details about it later. Exploration will also be amplified, with more secrets, shortcuts, elevators (YAY!), puzzles, and overall better level design than REDO!

Essentially, SESSIONS will be similar to REDO!, but much more ambitious. Bigger, faster, more creepy etc.
There's a lot more to say, but let's stop here today.

Thank you!
